title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
Finance \& Accounts Executive

We are looking for a **responsible, detail\-oriented, and proactive Finance \& Accounts Executive** to manage the day\-to\-day accounting and financial activities of our bakery business.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of **accounting, billing, bank reconciliation, receivables, payables, expenses, and financial records**, along with the ability to work accurately and independently.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain accurate day\-to\-day accounting records and supporting documents.
* Record and verify **sales, purchases, expenses, receipts and payments**.
* Handle **cash and bank entries and regular bank reconciliation**.
* Monitor **receivables, payables, supplier accounts, and customer accounts**.
* Verify invoices, bills, vouchers and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the billing team and ensure proper sales and accounting records.
* Assist with **GST\-related records, documentation and reconciliations**.
* Prepare daily, monthly and management reports as required.
* Assist with **cost monitoring, expense control and financial analysis**.
* Support payroll and salary\-related accounting activities when required.
* Assist in month\-end and year\-end closing activities.
* Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants and other authorised professionals.
* Maintain proper filing and documentation of financial records.
* Ensure confidentiality of financial and business information.
* Identify discrepancies or irregularities and report them promptly to management.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong knowledge of basic accounting principles.
* Good working knowledge of **Tally/accounting software and MS Excel**.
* Knowledge of GST and statutory accounting requirements.
* Good numerical and analytical ability.
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to reconcile accounts and identify discrepancies.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
* Previous experience in **retail, bakery, FMCG, manufacturing, or similar businesses** will be an advantage.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to take **real ownership of the finance and accounts function** rather than simply performing data\-entry work. The role will provide exposure to day\-to\-day business operations, financial controls, costing, reporting and management decision support.

**If you are organised, accountable and passionate about getting numbers right, we would like to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Finance Executive
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and responsible Finance Executive with 2–3

years of experience in accounting and finance operations. The ideal candidate

should have hands\-on experience in day\-to\-day accounting, accounts payable and

receivable, bank reconciliation, GST/TDS compliance, and financial reporting.

The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records and

supporting the finance team in ensuring timely and efficient accounting operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain day\-to\-day accounting transactions and financial records.
* Prepare and maintain sales, purchase, receipt, and payment entries.
* Manage Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR).
* Perform regular bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare invoices, payment requests, debit/credit notes, and supporting documents.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and follow up for timely settlements.
* Assist in GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance activities.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities.
* Assist in the preparation of financial statements, MIS reports, and management reports.
* Maintain proper documentation and filing of accounting records.
* Coordinate with auditors, vendors, customers, and internal departments when required.
* Ensure compliance with company accounting policies and procedures.
* Apply GAAP and applicable accounting standards, policies, and procedures in maintaining accurate accounting transactions, financial records, and reports.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* B.Com, M.Com, or MBA (Finance) from a recognized university or institution.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
* Good knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, and financialaccounting.
* Good knowledge of accounting standards, GAAP, and standardaccounting procedures.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and other statutory compliancerequirements.
* Hands\-on experience with MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally,Zoho Books, or similar ERP systems.
* Good understanding of Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), bank reconciliation, and ledger reconciliation.
* Good numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Executive
description:
Job Summary (UAE VAT compliance through **FTA EmaraTax**)

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and experienced **Accountant / Finance Executive** to manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, financial records, reconciliations, VAT compliance and management reporting.

The role will be responsible for maintaining accurate accounts in **Xero**, ensuring timely accounts receivable and payable processes, supporting UAE VAT compliance through **FTA EmaraTax**, and assisting with Corporate Tax and financial reporting requirements.

Key Responsibilities1\. Accounting \& Bookkeeping

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date books of accounts in **Xero**.
* Record sales invoices, supplier bills, expenses, receipts and other financial transactions.
* Ensure accounting records are complete, accurate and properly supported by documentation.
* Maintain organized digital and physical financial records.

2\. Bank \& Account Reconciliation

* Perform regular reconciliation of:
* Bank accounts
* Credit cards
* Payment gateways and other payment platforms
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies promptly.
* Ensure all transactions are correctly recorded and allocated.

3\. Accounts Receivable

* Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and on time.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and maintain an up\-to\-date aged debtor report.
* Follow up with customers regarding overdue payments.
* Allocate customer receipts and maintain accurate customer account balances.
* Escalate long\-outstanding or disputed balances to management.

4\. Accounts Payable

* Process supplier invoices and verify supporting documentation.
* Maintain accurate supplier accounts and payment schedules.
* Prepare payment runs for management approval.
* Monitor supplier balances and ensure payments are processed within agreed terms.
* Investigate discrepancies between invoices, purchase records and supplier statements.

5\. VAT Compliance

* Prepare **quarterly UAE VAT returns** and supporting schedules.
* Support VAT return submission through the **FTA EmaraTax portal**.
* Maintain VAT records and supporting documentation in accordance with UAE Federal Tax Authority requirements.
* Ensure transactions are appropriately recorded for VAT purposes.
* Coordinate with tax advisors or management on VAT\-related queries when required.

6\. Management Reporting

Prepare and provide accurate monthly financial reports, including:

* Profit \& Loss Statement
* Balance Sheet
* Aged Receivables / Debtors
* Aged Payables / Creditors
* Bank and cash position
* Other financial reports required by management

Provide relevant commentary on significant movements, discrepancies or unusual transactions.

7\. Month\-End \& Year\-End Closing

* Support monthly and annual financial closing processes.
* Ensure accounting entries, accruals, adjustments and reconciliations are completed on time.
* Prepare schedules and supporting documentation required for financial reporting.
* Liaise with external auditors, accountants and tax advisors as required.

8\. Corporate Tax Compliance

* Maintain appropriate records and documentation required for **UAE Corporate Tax compliance**.
* Support Corporate Tax calculations, reporting and compliance activities as required.
* Coordinate with external tax advisors where applicable.
* Ensure relevant financial information and supporting records are readily available for tax compliance.

9\. Financial Control \& Risk Monitoring

* Identify and promptly report cash\-flow concerns, accounting discrepancies and unusual transactions to management.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls over receipts, payments and accounting records.
* Support management in monitoring cash flow and working capital.
* Ensure confidentiality and security of financial information.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related field**.
* Professional accounting qualification such as **CA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent** is an advantage.
* Relevant experience in accounting and bookkeeping, preferably within the UAE.
* Practical experience with **Xero** is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of **UAE VAT and FTA requirements**.
* Familiarity with **EmaraTax** and UAE Corporate Tax requirements.
* Strong understanding of accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliations and financial reporting.
* Good working knowledge of Excel / Microsoft Office.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: FP&A - Jr. Analyst
description:

Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards **Click Here.**


We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**Position Summary**


The FP\&A \- Jr. Analyst supports financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities across the organization. This role provides an excellent opportunity for early\-career finance professionals to develop technical finance expertise, analytical capabilities, business acumen, and stakeholder management skills while partnering with finance and business teams to support data\-driven decision\-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support budgeting, forecasting, month\-end close, and financial reporting processes.
* Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and key business drivers.
* Assist in preparing management reports, Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), presentations, and ad hoc analyses.
* Perform account reconciliations, data validation, and financial control activities to ensure the accuracy and integrity of reporting.
* Work with large datasets and leverage analytical tools to generate actionable business insights.
* Support variance analysis by investigating actual versus plan performance and preparing meaningful explanations.
* Collaborate with finance teams and business stakeholders to understand operational drivers and support informed decision\-making.
* Utilize finance systems and planning tools such as Workday, Adaptive Planning, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot and automation solutions to improve productivity, analysis, and reporting efficiency.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, standardization, and automation of recurring activities.
* Support internal and external audit requirements through timely and accurate documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* 0\-1 year of relevant experience in Finance, Accounting, FP\&A, Audit, or Financial Reporting.
* Strong understanding of accounting and financial concepts.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and quantitative skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrate curiosity, learning agility, and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to financial planning, forecasting, reporting, or business analysis.
* Experience with Workday, Adaptive Planning, Power BI, or similar finance systems.

title: Accounts Manager - Finance & Accounts
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, including balance sheets and cash flow statements.

Manage day\-to\-day bookkeeping, general ledger maintenance, and journal entries.

Record daily financial transactions (cash receipts, bank payments, sales, and purchases) accurately into the general ledger.

Perform regular Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS).

Accounts Payable \& Receivable (AP/AR): Process vendor invoices, manage vendor payouts, track client billing, and aggressively follow up on outstanding payments.

Bank \& Account Reconciliations: Reconcile bank statements and client/vendor ledgers regularly to resolve any financial discrepancies.

Reconcile payroll accounts during period\-end closes including salary statement preparation, preparation of statutory compilence.

Generate daily, weekly, and monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports for executive leadership.

Handle statutory compliances (such as GST, TDS, PF, and ESI) depending on regional requirements.

Coordinate internal and external audits with financial consultants and tax authorities.

Requirements:

* **Accounting Software:** Proficiency in enterprise accounting software like Tally ERP.
* **Tax Knowledge:** Working knowledge of regional tax frameworks, specifically regarding TDS and GST in India, or relevant local statutory regulations.
* **Analytical Thinking:** High attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and anomalies in financial data.

Pay: ₹24,500\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Account management: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Finance Assistant & Operations Executive
description:

7\.Reporting: Generating regular reports on billing activities, such as outstanding invoices, revenue forecasts, or billing trends, for management review.

8\.Compliance: Ensuring compliance with relevant billing regulations, policies, and procedures.

9\.Collaboration: Collaborating with other departments, such as finance, sales, or customer service, to ensure smooth billing operations and resolve any issues promptly.
